# First, filter the dataframe to only include rows within the year range 1995 to 2009 inclusive
df_filtered = df[(df['year'] >= 1995) & (df['year'] <= 2009)]

# Count the number of prizes (rows) for each beer within this period
prize_counts = df_filtered['beer name'].value_counts()

# Identify the beer with the maximum count (most decorated)
most_decorated_beer = prize_counts.idxmax()

# Check if 'maggs magnificent mild' is the most decorated beer
answer = most_decorated_beer == 'maggs magnificent mild'
